text: {"features":[{"name":"Production software engineering maturity","description":"How convincingly the letter presents hands-on experience testing, maintaining, launching, and operating production software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Lists software experience in a bare credentialing way and gives little sense of owning production systems through maintenance, launch, or operation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some direct production exposure but only limited scope, such as a small number of services or unclear lifecycle responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly presents solid qualifying experience with production services and at least moderate responsibility for testing, maintenance, or launch."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes multi-year ownership of several production systems with evidence of both building them and keeping them running."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys strong engineering maturity through sustained stewardship of production systems over years, often showing progression in scope or responsibility."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes Go as a meaningful, role-relevant part of the applicant's background.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Identifies Go only briefly or as one language among many, with no clear sense of depth, primacy, or recency."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States experience in Go but gives little indication that it is a major working language or a source of backend strength."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is a regular working language used in current or recent professional work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Positions Go as a primary language and ties it to multiple production services or infrastructure systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a core strength used extensively in production back-end or agent-supporting systems central to the applicant's work."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes production-relevant Python experience for tooling, services, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no clear Python evidence or only a token mention with no example of actual use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Notes some Python familiarity but frames it mainly as incidental scripting or secondary exposure."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, automation, prototypes, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial Python ownership in production contexts, such as internal services, automation layers, or AI-related systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major production-grade capability with concrete evidence of robust services, tooling, or agent implementations that others rely on."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic sophistication","description":"How well the letter demonstrates practical command of data structures and algorithms through relevant examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of algorithmic work or relies only on generic claims about problem solving."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions algorithmic strength in vague terms without a concrete example or observable effect."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one concrete example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear, recent, and role-relevant algorithmic work that affected performance, scalability, or correctness."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates standout algorithmic sophistication with specific examples of redesigning core logic or choosing structures that materially transformed a system."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows hands-on ability to perform security assessments and follow findings through remediation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no clear evidence of conducting security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security reviews or assessments briefly but does not explain method, scope, or follow-through."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States direct experience with threat modeling, reviews, or assessments and indicates at least some remediation involvement."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes meaningful assessment practice across new and existing systems, including concrete methods such as threat models, code review, or remediation verification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys deep, credible assessment ability by framing security review as sustained engineering work with explicit methods, attacker-minded analysis, and validation of fixes."}]},{"name":"Security workflow automation","description":"How strongly the letter shows experience automating security processes such as vulnerability intake, triage, routing, or report handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention automating any security workflow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers generally to automation in security without specifying the workflow or the applicant's role in it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building automation around vulnerability handling or triage in clear but moderate detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial ownership of automating security workflows, such as classifying, routing, deduplicating, or prioritizing vulnerability reports."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security automation as a major accomplishment, with concrete detail on replacing manual handling at scale and freeing expert attention for higher-value work."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture depth","description":"How well the letter demonstrates design and implementation of agentic systems relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or uses the term without describing any actual system."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agent-based work briefly but gives little sense of architecture, ownership, or control model."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states experience designing or building agents, usually with Python agents and supporting services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes end-to-end agentic architecture with meaningful ownership of how agents act, coordinate, or interact with backend systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sophisticated agentic design thinking by emphasizing bounded autonomy, clear contracts, auditability, permissions, or other guardrails around production agents."}]},{"name":"AI application maturity","description":"How credibly the letter presents practical experience applying AI or language models in production settings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of AI work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI or language models only generically, with no deployment or reliability detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States hands-on AI feature work in production or near-production contexts."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Couples AI experience with concrete attention to evaluation, trustworthiness, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates mature AI engineering judgment by describing production use of AI where correctness mattered and explaining how the systems were made dependable."}]},{"name":"Role understanding","description":"How clearly the letter shows understanding of this specific role's mix of security automation, vulnerability handling, AI agents, and developer support.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a generic software or security letter with little connection to the posted responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows partial relevance but addresses only one slice of the role, such as backend work or security, without connecting the broader mandate."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects the applicant to several major parts of the role, such as security tooling, automation, or agentic systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates a strong read of the role by explicitly linking background to secure-by-default tooling, vulnerability handling, and internal impact."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows unusually precise understanding of the role by integrating its specific responsibilities into the applicant's narrative and explaining why this exact mandate fits their experience."}]},{"name":"Security mission commitment","description":"How strongly the letter conveys genuine motivation to work in security engineering rather than treating security as incidental to backend work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives little sense of why security matters to the applicant beyond the job title."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses general interest in security impact but without a personal or thoughtful rationale."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a clear interest in security engineering and ties it to prior work, values, or desired impact."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sustained, thoughtful motivation around prevention, resilience, attacker thinking, or secure systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys a compelling security-engineering identity, with a memorable rationale that makes the motivation feel intrinsic and durable."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"How strongly the letter values foundational systems whose improvements scale across many products or teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Focuses only on personal fit or general software work with no mention of broad organizational leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Briefly mentions scale or infrastructure but not as a central motivation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly values working on systems with broad downstream impact."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently frames past work and future interest around central platforms, internal tooling, or multiplier effects across teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes platform leverage a defining theme, persuasively linking prior choices and this role to company-wide impact through foundational infrastructure."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"How well the letter frames security work as enabling other engineers through low-friction tools and secure defaults.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not discuss serving or enabling developer teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at helping others but does not connect that idea to security workflow or tool design."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in reducing manual work or making the secure path easier for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear empathy for product teams and describes building tools or defaults that make secure behavior easier in practice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates a strong developer-enablement philosophy, explicitly centering low-friction workflows, secure defaults, and practical adoption by busy engineers."}]},{"name":"Collaboration orientation","description":"How well the letter signals readiness to partner closely with security engineers and other internal stakeholders.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Makes no meaningful mention of partnership or internal stakeholder work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses generic team language without showing cross-functional security context or internal customer awareness."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some awareness of working with other engineers or serving internal users."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly emphasizes partnering with security specialists or product teams to solve security problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a strong cross-functional model in which the applicant translates security expertise into tools and workflows that other teams can readily adopt."}]},{"name":"Self-directed security practice","description":"How much the letter shows security skill development beyond day-to-day job duties through certifications or competitive practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of security practice outside regular work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a basic credential or occasional practice without showing much depth or continuity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing security development through recurring CTF participation or a foundational certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a strong external security signal, such as OSCP or sustained competitive CTF performance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-driven security practice through both rigorous credentials and high-level adversarial practice, or one of those at especially strong intensity."}]},{"name":"Self-directed technical initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows building or maintaining substantive technical work outside assigned job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of meaningful technical initiative beyond regular work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small or generic personal project with limited scope or relevance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a solid extra-professional project or occasional open-source contribution."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates sustained initiative through ambitious systems projects or active open-source maintenance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-direction by owning substantial distributed systems projects, widely used open-source work, or both, with clear evidence of rigor and responsibility."}]},{"name":"Concrete evidence specificity","description":"How much the letter supports claims with concrete examples, technologies, situations, or accomplishments rather than general assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on generic claims and abstractions with few specific examples."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a small number of specifics, but many claims remain broad or unsupported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides several concrete examples tied to relevant technologies or tasks."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds qualifications in specific projects, responsibilities, or technical details."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Builds a highly persuasive case through rich, specific, role-relevant examples that make the applicant's claims easy to picture and trust."}]},{"name":"Outcome articulation","description":"How clearly the letter explains the results or impact of the work it describes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Lists activities without saying what changed or why the work mattered."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Implies positive outcomes but leaves impact mostly unstated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States some concrete effects, such as reduced manual work, improved performance, or broader adoption."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Regularly links work to meaningful outcomes for teams, systems, or security posture."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes impact vivid and convincing through clear results, scale, or measured benefits that show why the work mattered."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How easy the letter is to follow as a logically structured, well-paced argument for fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels disjointed or poorly sequenced, making the case hard to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a discernible structure but uneven flow or abrupt transitions that weaken the argument."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally well organized, with a clear progression through motivation, qualifications, and fit."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Flows smoothly from motivation to evidence to fit, with strong transitions and little wasted motion."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a particularly coherent narrative in which each paragraph builds naturally toward a compelling overall case."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the letter is at the sentence level in spelling, grammar, and proofreading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent mechanical errors that repeatedly distract from the content or undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several noticeable errors that interrupt reading but do not obscure meaning."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a few errors or awkward phrasings, but overall reads as competent and professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is cleanly written with only rare minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally polished, with essentially no distracting errors and strong control of written English."}]}]}
